The '''DH77 headcomm''' was a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] developed by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Initial successes with the DH77 led to its widespread use at the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] level in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]],<ref name="ISB" /> and installed in [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|helmets]]. The DH77 used linked encoding sequences which allowed the comlink to shift communications frequencies every few [[Standard second|seconds]]. The system also kept all the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the unit synchronized to the same frequencies. The coding sequences were automatically deleted if the helmet was removed without first triggering the comlink's control stud.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> 

However, a serious flaw with the DH77 headcomm was discovered; the unit could be easily jammed by the presence of high energy particle emissions. Artillery explosions could create dead zones in which transmissions from DH77s were lost, and interference from a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] contrail could jam DH77s with a range of three [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. Despite the introduction of [[Herzfall Corporation/Legends|Herzfall Corporation's]] [[DH107/Legends|DH107]], an improved comlink that was less prone to the problems that plagued the DH77, thousands of DH77s had been issued to field units, and replacement of the units was a low priority for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ISB" />
